title: Keyboard shortcuts
help: Shortcuts of the menu bar's items, shown next to them in the menu. A change applies at once. System keys such as {quit}, {close} and {minimize} can't be used.
recording: Press the new keys… (Esc to cancel)

problem.invalid: That key can't be part of a shortcut. Use a letter, a digit, a punctuation key or F1–F24.
problem.needsModifier: Hold {mod} too, so the shortcut doesn't fire while typing.
problem.reserved: {keys} belongs to the system or to text editing, so it can't be used.
problem.taken: {keys} is already the shortcut of “{action}”. Change or remove that one first.
